settings.title: Activity

share.label: Share my activity
share.description: Shows on your profile the game or app you are using, like "Playing Minecraft". It works in the Linkord desktop app, which only recognizes games and apps from a known list.

settings.gamesDescription: A hidden game or app is never shown to others, even with sharing on.
settings.detectedEmpty: No game or app detected yet. Open one while Linkord is running and it shows up here.
settings.desktopOnly: Detection happens in the Linkord desktop app. In the browser you only choose whether to share.

errors.offline: No connection to the server. Try again in a moment.
